key_insights: BTC is testing the 20K previous cycle all-time high level with 14K as next major support
The 200-week moving average has flipped from support to resistance, marking a significant shift in market structure
Bullish reversal requires either a weekly close above 200-week MA or a higher low formation at 19.6K-20.6K
Macro headwinds from CPI data and earnings could pressure markets further
Correlation with S&P 500 remains strong until proven otherwise
summary: BTC is in a downtrend testing the critical 20K support level with next support at 14K. The 200-week moving average has flipped from support to resistance, requiring either a weekly reclaim or a higher low formation at 19.6-20.6K for bullish reversal signals. Macro headwinds from inflation and earnings data pose additional risks. Altcoins remain uninteresting until BTC/ETH show higher time frame resolution.
